instruction_bn: নিচের বিষয়ে ২০০ শব্দের মধ্যে comparison/cause-effect paragraph লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা দেখো (Board: 15 marks)।

items.prompt: Write a paragraph on 'Causes and Effects of Load-shedding' (cause and effect).
items.model: Load-shedding is a common problem in our country. It means the temporary cut of electricity supply. There are several causes of load-shedding. The main cause is that our production of electricity is much less than our demand. Moreover, the wastage of electricity, illegal connections and the system loss also cause load-shedding. As a result of load-shedding, our daily life is greatly hampered. Students cannot study properly at night. Mills and factories cannot run smoothly, so the production falls. Patients in hospitals suffer a lot. Because of frequent load-shedding, valuable electrical goods are often damaged. In the hot summer, load-shedding makes our life miserable. It also affects the economy of the country badly. To reduce load-shedding, we should build more power plants and use electricity carefully. We must not waste electricity and should turn off unnecessary lights and fans. Only then can we get relief from this serious problem.
